changes.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized in ‘serious but stable’ condition, family says
changes.summary: Perez Hilton was in serious condition Saturday at a Florida hospital after he livestreamed what appeared to be self-harm from his Miami-area home Tuesday night, his family said in a statement.

changes.title: Perez Hilton’s family says his children ‘fled’ their home before his reported self-harm livestream
changes.summary: The family said they “fled to protect from witnessing any further trauma” after “it became clear” that Hilton was “harming himself.”.

changes.title: Perez Hilton hospitalized after livestreaming acts of self-harm, officials say
changes.summary: In the livestream, which has since been taken down, Hilton appears to be bloodied and in a distressed mental state.

changes.title: Perez Hilton Hospitalized After Reports He Livestreamed Self-Harm
changes.summary: Police responded to the Miami-area home of celebrity blogger and podcaster Perez Hilton after reports that engaged in self-harm in live-streamed TikTok video. A statement from the Miami-Dade sheriff’s office did not name Hilton but says the individual was “safely recovered” and taken to the hospital.
